name: com.envisioning/mcp
title: Envisioning
description: Search Envisioning's technology research, vocabulary and Hindsight graded forecasts. Read-only.

tools.name: search_site
tools.description: Search every page on envisioning.com: services, research hubs, technologies, vocabulary terms, reports, case studies, science-fiction origins, newsletter issues and methodology chapters. Returns titles and URLs; read one with get_page.

type.description: Limit to one kind of page

tools.name: get_page
tools.description: Read any envisioning.com page as Markdown, by path: /services, /methodology, /capability, /hindsight, /about, a research hub (/research/<hub>), a report (/observatory/<slug>). Includes the canonical URL and a citation line.

tools.name: list_hubs
tools.description: List Envisioning's research hubs: living collections of emerging technologies per domain (climate, defense, health, quantum and more), each with its technology count. Use a hub slug with search_technologies.

tools.name: search_technologies
tools.description: Search Envisioning's technology research (over 4,000 technologies across all hubs) by words in the title or summary, optionally within one hub. Each result has a technology readiness level (TRL), impact and investment rating, and its URL. Read one in full with get_technology.

query.description: Words to match; omit to list a hub

tools.name: get_technology
tools.description: Read one technology in full as Markdown: description, ratings, related technologies and sources. Takes the hub and id from search_technologies.

tools.name: search_vocab
tools.description: Search Envisioning's AI and machine-learning vocabulary (an encyclopedia of terms, concepts and techniques) by words in the term or its summary.

tools.name: get_vocab_term
tools.description: Read one vocabulary term in full as Markdown, by slug from search_vocab.

tools.name: search_hindsight
tools.description: Search Hindsight: published technology forecasts (IMF, OECD, Gartner, MIT Technology Review, Kurzweil and others) graded against what happened. Search by subject, e.g. 'quantum computing'. Each subject lists its forecasts with publisher, year and verdict. Use it for base rates before you trust a new forecast. Read one forecast with get_hindsight_claim.

tools.name: get_hindsight_claim
tools.description: Read one graded forecast as Markdown: what was predicted, by whom and when, the verdict, the evidence and the citation. Takes a claim id from search_hindsight.
